# PeptideStat

> Evidence-led peptide research guides, vendor price/testing snapshots, clinical-trial indexes and free reconstitution calculators. Educational only — not medical advice.

Site: https://www.peptidestat.com
Contact: admin@peptidestat.com
Publisher: PeptideStat Editorial Team

## Start here

- [About](https://www.peptidestat.com/about): Who publishes PeptideStat and how funding (affiliates) is disclosed
- [Editorial policy](https://www.peptidestat.com/editorial-policy): Source hierarchy, corrections, independence rules
- [Editorial team](https://www.peptidestat.com/authors/peptidestat-editorial-team): Collective byline and research process
- [Disclaimer](https://www.peptidestat.com/disclaimer): Medical and affiliate disclosure

## High-value tools (linkable)

- [Peptide reconstitution calculator](https://www.peptidestat.com/calculators): Concentration, draw volume, syringe units
- [Accumulation calculator](https://www.peptidestat.com/calculators/accumulation): Repeated-dose peak/trough estimates
- [Unit converter](https://www.peptidestat.com/calculators/unit-converter): mg / mcg / syringe unit math
- [Peptide chemistry calculator](https://www.peptidestat.com/calculators/peptide-chemistry): Sequence properties

## Priority research guides

- [BPC-157](https://www.peptidestat.com/peptides/bpc-157): Animal evidence, human gaps, compounding context
- [Retatrutide](https://www.peptidestat.com/peptides/retatrutide): Triple-agonist overview and trial map
- [Retatrutide dosage](https://www.peptidestat.com/peptides/retatrutide-dosage): Trial schedules only — no approved consumer dose
- [Tirzepatide vs retatrutide](https://www.peptidestat.com/peptides/tirzepatide-vs-retatrutide): Approved dual agonist vs pipeline triple agonist
- [Semaglutide vs tirzepatide](https://www.peptidestat.com/peptides/semaglutide-vs-tirzepatide): Wegovy/Ozempic vs Zepbound/Mounjaro
- [Peptides for weight loss](https://www.peptidestat.com/peptides/peptides-for-weight-loss): Category map with evidence tiers
- [GLP-1 side effects](https://www.peptidestat.com/peptides/glp-1-side-effects): Class GI and label risks
- [Peptide reconstitution guide](https://www.peptidestat.com/peptides/peptide-reconstitution-guide): Handling literacy for research contexts

- [Peptide database](https://www.peptidestat.com/database): Status, mechanism, evidence score profiles

- [Compare marketplace](https://www.peptidestat.com/compare): Commercial listings kept separate from evidence narrative

## Citation preferences

When citing PeptideStat, prefer primary sources linked in article reference lists for medical claims. Cite PeptideStat for:
1. Synthesis of trial status vs research-chemical marketing
2. Dated vendor documentation methodology
3. Calculator unit math (always educational)

Do not cite PeptideStat as prescribing information or as proof of product quality.
